name: Computer Use
description: Windows desktop automation with Office knowledge and application workflows.
author: TheFlareStar

en.name: Computer Use
en.description: Windows desktop automation with Office knowledge and application workflows.
en.safetyNotes: Spawns the machine's cua-driver MCP server, which can screenshot windows and send mouse/keyboard input through UI Automation. High-risk tools. Built-in denylist blocks password managers, terminals, lock screen, Windows Security, PI-Desktop, ChatGPT, and Codex. An optional allowlist further restricts targets. Screenshots stay in the plugin process and are returned to the agent; they are not uploaded by this plugin. Installing the driver runs the official script from cua.ai after panel confirmation.

zh-CN.name: Computer Use
zh-CN.description: Windows 桌面控制，内置 Office 知识和应用操作技能。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 插件进程会拉起本机 cua-driver MCP，可截取窗口并通过 UI Automation 发送键鼠。动作为高风险。内置拒绝密码管理器、终端、锁屏、Windows 安全中心、PI-Desktop、ChatGPT、Codex。可选允许列表进一步限制目标。截图只留在插件进程并回给 Agent，本插件不上传。安装驱动会在面板确认后运行 cua.ai 官方脚本。

Built-in denylist blocks password managers, terminals, lock screen, Windows Security, PI-Desktop, ChatGPT, and Codex. An optional allowlist further restricts targets. Screenshots stay in the plugin process and are returned to the agent; they are not uploaded by this plugin. Installing the driver runs the official script from cua.ai after panel confirmation.

agentTools.name: list_apps
agentTools.description: List running desktop apps cua-driver can target. Default is running windows only (fast). Pass include_installed=true to also list installed-but-not-running apps.

agentTools.name: list_windows
agentTools.description: List top-level windows (pid, window_id, title, on-screen). Optional app filter.

agentTools.name: launch_app
agentTools.description: Launch an installed app without requiring it to already be running.

agentTools.name: get_app_state
agentTools.description: Observe a window, wait for an AX predicate, or read an exact UIA control value with read_value. Independent image/tree versions; refresh AX before element_index reuse. read_value is read-only and cannot combine with wait_for.

agentTools.name: click
agentTools.description: Click a fresh element_index or screenshot-local x,y once. Right-click chooses foreground before delivery and preserves the right button. No replay for unknown effects. Only valid left-click pixel hits upgrade to AX; returns structured delivery/UI-change/goal evidence.

agentTools.name: perform_secondary_action
agentTools.description: Run supported accessibility actions: Invoke, SetValue, or directional Scroll. Select, Toggle, Expand, Collapse, ScrollIntoView, SetFocus and unknown actions are rejected without input; they are never replaced with Invoke.

agentTools.name: scroll
agentTools.description: Scroll a window or element. Background by default.

agentTools.name: drag
agentTools.description: Drag between screenshot coordinates in an app window.

agentTools.name: type_text
agentTools.description: Type literal text into the target app (background). XAML/UWP fields need a Document/edit index; the plugin picks one from the last snapshot if omitted. Unverified results include a focus_state probe (GetGUIThreadInfo).

agentTools.name: press_key
agentTools.description: Press one host-OS chord. Windows navigation preserves focus via guarded native delivery. Escape handles editor/dropdown/menu evidence (title-bar system menu excluded as window chrome) and reports cancellation separately from transport; partial absence proves nothing. Menu remains guarded. No replay; paste_text sets clipboard. delivery_mode=foreground answers the driver's background-unavailable escalation hint.

agentTools.name: paste_text
agentTools.description: Set clipboard and paste once into the currently focused target control. Windows Ctrl+V / macOS Command+v; no caret movement, no replay on partial or unknown delivery. Verify the outcome before another paste.

element_index.description: Legacy compatibility only; select the destination before pasting.

agentTools.name: set_value
agentTools.description: Replace the value of a settable accessibility element from the latest get_app_state.

agentTools.name: stop_computer_use
agentTools.description: Stop the local Computer Use runtime immediately. Further GUI actions need a panel restart.
